title: VIP Intelligence Systems — Prediction Ledger, Evidence Engine, Cycle Detection, Field Modes
source: Conversation synthesis (card-market case testing: Mega Greninja ex SIR, vintage Pokémon lot, Drew Brees HOF, Blastoise/Piplup synergy) + CardSight identification architecture proposal
instructions_for_cursor: This file is the source of truth for sequencing. Each system has a status. ONLY build 'approved' status items now. 'proposed' items get schema/interfaces only — no scoring logic — so nothing breaks when the blocked dependency lands. 'blocked' items should not be started; their dependency is listed. Do not reorder phases. Do not merge Field Intelligence into Intelligence Core — they are different layers (backend scoring vs. capture/workflow UX) and conflating them was flagged explicitly as a scope risk.

systems.name: Prediction Ledger
systems.rationale: Highest priority per source conversation. Buildable today against existing holding/asset data. No external dependency.
blocks: market_cycle_detector calibration reporting (needs ledger to score itself)
systems.test_fixture: Mega Greninja ex SIR — $230, 90-day horizon, 55% down / 30% sideways / 15% up
acceptance_criteria: A prediction, once written, is never mutated except to add resolution fields after resolves_at
Querying all resolved predictions for an asset category returns a directional-accuracy % and a systematic-bias note (e.g. underestimates post-release compression)
Unresolved predictions past their resolves_at date surface in a 'needs scoring' view

systems.name: Recommendation Evidence Engine
systems.rationale: Buildable today. Existing eBay Browse adapter already produces timestamped observations that map directly to evidence rows. Prevents the stale-advice failure mode already identified in conversation.
blocks: Every other recommendation-producing system should attach evidence_card_id once this exists — retrofit, not a new dependency
systems.test_fixture: BUY — Crown Zenith PC ETB, confidence 94%, shelf observation 2h old, market comps 14h old, expires 48h
acceptance_criteria: Every row in recommendation carries at least one evidence_card row
A recommendation past expires_at is flagged stale in any read API, not silently served as current
evidence_source is a controlled vocabulary (shelf_observation, ebay_browse, sold_comp, ownership_record, collection_fit_score, manual) not free text

systems.name: Market Cycle Detector
systems.rationale: Classification logic (FOMO/Cooling/Accumulation/Recovery/Blue Chip/Bubble Risk) needs population growth, sales velocity, listing supply, social intensity — these are Signals system inputs which are still PROPOSED per the reference manual, not built.
depends_on: Signals ingestion (signals_raw / signals_normalized) — currently delegated to Cursor, not confirmed live
systems.blocked_reason: Do not write scoring logic yet. Schema and the table shape may be built now so Prediction Ledger and Evidence Engine can reference cycle_state by FK once populated.
systems.test_fixture: Drew Brees post-HOF: catalyst occurred -> attention peaked -> event passed -> commodity cards soften -> evaluate accumulation window
acceptance_criteria: Table exists and accepts manual/backfilled rows so the Brees case can be entered by hand as a validation fixture before automation exists
cycle_state is a constrained enum, not free text
No cron job, no automated classification job ships in this phase

systems.name: Lull Candidate / Buy Opportunity Scanner
systems.rationale: Same signals dependency as Market Cycle Detector; the two are designed to work together (cycle detector classifies, scanner screens/ranks).
systems.blocked_reason: Screening logic needs the same inputs as cycle detector. Build schema only.
acceptance_criteria: Table exists; no scheduled scan job ships yet

systems.name: Acquisition Underwriting Engine (incl. Acquisition Coverage Ratio)
systems.rationale: Fully specified with a real worked case (vintage Pokémon lot, $700 offer / $1,045 LP value / 1.49x). Math is deterministic, no external data dependency beyond values the user already supplies at underwriting time.
systems.test_fixture: $700 offer / $1,045 conservative LP value = 1.49x coverage ratio; 1.30x minimum threshold for uncertain vintage lots
acceptance_criteria: acquisition_coverage_ratio is a generated/computed column: conservative_raw_value / offer_price
Rows below the configurable minimum threshold (default 1.30) are flagged, not blocked — human makes the call
Underwriting record is immutable once linked to a completed transaction

systems.name: Intelligent Submission Manager / Grading Optimizer
systems.rationale: Already an approved concept per source doc, validated against a real case (Flareon, Jolteon, Snorlax, Chansey). Deterministic expected-value math once per-grade probability/value inputs are supplied — no live signals dependency to START; population/pop-report data can be entered manually or backfilled later.
systems.test_fixture: Flareon / Jolteon / Snorlax / Chansey manual PSA-tier calculations
acceptance_criteria: recommendation is a constrained enum: GRADE / HOLD_RAW / SELL_RAW / INSPECT_FURTHER
grading_opportunity_score is 0-100, stored not just computed on read, so it can be indexed/sorted for a submission queue

expected_incremental_profit = expected_grading_value - raw_value - grading_cost - shipping_cost - insurance_cost - selling_expense - opportunity_cost, and each term is a separate stored column (no opaque single number)

systems.name: Portfolio Consolidation Engine (Collection Quality Density)
systems.rationale: New concept, not yet validated against a worked case the way underwriting/grading were. Formula (museum + investment + scarcity + liquidity + synergy / capital deployed) references collection_synergy_score which does not exist until VIP Collection Intelligence (museum_score system) ships.
systems.blocked_reason: Schema may be built now; scoring logic waits for collection_synergy_score to exist.
acceptance_criteria: Table exists; no automated consolidation suggestions generated until dependency lands

systems.name: Collection Synergy / Museum Score
systems.rationale: Fully specified with a real case (Blastoise & Piplup). Scores are computed from data already in vault_collection.holding (museum_score, investment_score, liquidity_score already exist as columns) plus new binder/collection-goal linkage.
systems.test_fixture: Blastoise Master Collection + Tag Team Master Collection dual contribution example
acceptance_criteria: collection_synergy_score is never collapsed into a single opaque number without the component scores also being visible/queryable
contributing_goals is an array referencing collection_hunt/binder goal IDs, not free text

systems.name: Binder Chase Architecture (Museum Page tiers)
systems.rationale: Concept is locked per user. Directly extends the existing Collection Hunt module (already BUILT/PROVEN per reference manual) rather than introducing a new subsystem.
systems.test_fixture: 9-card Museum Page per Pokémon expansion; Tier 1 Museum Anchor through Tier 4 Filler
acceptance_criteria: tier is a constrained enum: museum_anchor / binder_core / completion / filler
A page with >=8/9 slots filled and missing slots individually cheap surfaces a rip_vs_singles_recommendation of RIP; a page missing 1-2 expensive slots surfaces BUY_SINGLES
Cultural Icons binder is a separate page_type from set-based Museum Pages, not a variant of the same type

systems.name: Store / Show / Auction / Trade Modes
systems.rationale: These are capture/workflow UX layers that CONSUME the intelligence systems above — they are not themselves scoring engines. Explicitly kept as a separate layer per user decision so Cursor does not conflate backend intelligence with mobile/field UX.
depends_on: CardSight identification pipeline (for Store/Show photo capture)
systems.blocked_reason: Interfaces defined now so the intelligence systems expose what Field Modes will need. No mode UI or capture flow is built in this phase.
acceptance_criteria: field_session table exists as a container; no mode-specific business logic ships
Auction mode's max-bid calc and Trade mode's basket-equality calc are explicitly deferred, not stubbed with fake numbers

systems.name: CardSight Visual Identification Pipeline
systems.rationale: Validated architecture from a separate design discussion; Cursor Opus reported already building a version of this (CardSight + TCGdex + Scryfall/MTGJSON + Card Hedge) minus Yu-Gi-Oh and SportsCardsPro, which the user correctly scoped down further to avoid creep. This plan formalizes the interface contract so it doesn't diverge from what's being built in parallel.
systems.blocked_reason: Interfaces only. Do not add YuGiOh or SportsCardsPro. Do not hard-wire any provider.
hard_rules: VaultOS owns the canonical card_id; external IDs are references only
Identification candidates stored separately from confirmed identity
needs_review remains a permanent workflow state, never auto-cleared
Every identification stores provider + provider_version + timestamp + confidence
Never silently overwrite a confirmed identity when a provider later disagrees
Market price is a time-series observation table, never a single current_value field
Duplicate detection runs on both physical-item fingerprint AND canonical card identity
acceptance_criteria: A 100-250 card golden test deck exists with known answers before any pipeline change is considered validated
False-auto-confirm rate is the primary tracked metric, target well under exact-match accuracy tradeoffs (user explicitly prefers routing to needs_review over confident bad identity)

rejected_or_deferred_for_this_phase: Yu-Gi-Oh catalog provider (explicit scope-down by user)
AI/smart glasses interface (reference manual: phone-first before glasses, unconditionally)
Any automated cron/scheduled job for signals-dependent scoring (market_cycle_detector, buy_opportunity_scanner) until Signals ingestion is confirmed live
